artists.name: Signal Test Artist 01
artists.scene: Fictional alt-R&B micro-scene in a mid-size college city
artists.summary: Fictional artist used to test distributor-fit scoring with steady releases, dense repeat engagement, and clear community pull.
artists.recommendation: Watch for 30 days and validate whether repeat fan comments convert into measurable release saves.
artists.strategy: Run a low-cost release retargeting test around the strongest public content theme before any larger spend.
artists.disconfirmingEvidence: Engagement remains social-only with no public release activity, fan repetition weakens, or new posts show inflated ratios.

artists.name: Signal Test Artist 02
artists.stage: High visual momentum, catalog still shallow
artists.summary: Fictional artist used to test major-label and creator-partnership modes with strong awareness indicators but weaker recoupment confidence.
artists.recommendation: Needs more research before any buyer packet; pressure-test whether visible awareness maps to listener behavior.
artists.strategy: If validated, package as a creator-partnership test rather than a distributor-recoupment play.
artists.disconfirmingEvidence: Content views remain disconnected from catalog behavior or evidence depends on artist-reported metrics only.
risks: Unknown conversion from content to streams

artists.name: Signal Test Artist 03
artists.stage: Live scene traction, slower online growth
artists.scene: Fictional regional indie-rock and college-radio network
artists.summary: Fictional artist used to test management-growth mode with credible community and live-market proof but slower platform velocity.
artists.recommendation: Shortlist for management-growth review; map the live-market proof to next-market expansion.
artists.strategy: Use local audience density and support-slot history to plan a regional rollout with conservative spend.
artists.disconfirmingEvidence: Live turnout evidence is not repeatable outside the home market or catalog cadence slows.
risks: Online growth is slower than the category average
May require development time before distributor monetization
Press is regional rather than national
